title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 9: Kage Maru
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．９ 「影丸」
overview:
Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series is a series of eleven Sega Saturn discs released in Japan between October 1995 and March 1996, each containing images of one Virtua Fighter character.

This disc features Kage-Maru, born June 6, 1971; Japan. He is a tenth-generation Hagakure Ninja in Virtua Fighter. His fighting style, taught to him by his father, the ninth-generation, Hagakure-ryū Jū-Jutsu, a fictional martial arts that's based on Jujutsu.
